User story: As an authorized UoG platform or Site user, I want to expose Site-scoped authoring and taxonomy APIs so that the multi-site platform can operate securely and consistently.

Implementation requirements

Implement CRUD for Posts, Categories and Tags, list filters by status/category/tag/author/date, search, pagination, sort, typed validation and permission checks. Follow CMS API conventions.

Acceptance criteria

Authorized Site editors can create and update Posts and taxonomy.
All list/detail endpoints enforce Site ownership and permissions.
Filters, search, pagination and ordering behave predictably.
Duplicate slug and invalid taxonomy return actionable errors.
Disabled Posts module blocks Post and taxonomy administration.
OpenAPI schemas and integration tests exist.
Required tests / evidence: CRUD, filtering, unauthorized access, disabled module and schema tests.

Definition of Done: Code reviewed, tests automated and passing, migrations and Swagger/OpenAPI schemas updated where applicable, authorization/module gates verified, no critical/high unresolved defects, and a linked PR plus test evidence attached to the Azure DevOps Issue.
